observations: A large rounded head fills most of the frame against a black ground; the left eye socket holds a red X-crossed circle while the right shows a single dark pupil with a blue iris, both ringed in thick yellow loops.
A wide open mouth dominates the lower half, its teeth rendered as white rectangles cross-hatched with red lines, framed by deep red lips and a dark interior.
Blue oval dashes form a loose vertical chain down the left edge; pink splayed marks appear at lower left and lower right corners; a horizontal blue band cuts across the mid-left background.
reading: The face pushes close to the picture edge, leaving almost no breathing room. Its two eyes read differently—one sealed with crossing lines, one open and watching—giving the image an off-balance feeling that the symmetrical yellow rings around each socket cannot resolve. The wide, grid-toothed mouth sits somewhere between a grin and a grimace. Surrounding marks in blue, pink, and yellow feel less like decoration than like noise crowding in from every side.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbors #251 and #253 share the close-cropped face format and layered line work. #251 uses a pale open ground; #253 pulls back to a cooler, sparser field. #252 is the darkest of the three, with black filling nearly all negative space.

Title neighbor #253 shares yellow zigzag stitching lines and an asymmetric eye treatment, but its pale grey-blue ground makes the face feel exposed where #252 feels enclosed.
